groups.name: PCI Segmentation — iface_1
groups.description: PCI DSS 11.4.5 (annual, all entities) / 11.4.6 (every 6 months, service providers): prove that the segment behind adapter {iface_1} cannot reach the CDE. Run from the out-of-scope (non-CDE) or connected-to segment attached to {iface_1}. Any open port or live host is a segmentation failure. Requires root (raw sockets, -e).

items.name: iface_1: Source Segment Evidence
items.description: Record source IP, VLAN and routes of the test adapter. QSA evidence of where the test ran from.
items.command_template: ip -br addr show dev {iface_1}; ip route show dev {iface_1}; ip -d link show dev {iface_1} | grep -i vlan || true

items.name: iface_1: CDE Host Discovery
items.description: Multi-probe discovery (ICMP echo/timestamp, TCP SYN/ACK, UDP) toward the CDE through this adapter.

finding_template.title: PCI DSS 11.4.5 segmentation failure: CDE reachable from out-of-scope segment
finding_template.description: A CDE system answered from a segment that is supposed to be isolated from the CDE. Segmentation is not operational and effective, so the source segment is in PCI DSS scope.
finding_template.remediation: Restrict the flow at the segmentation control (firewall/ACL/VLAN) to deny all traffic from out-of-scope segments to the CDE, then re-run the segmentation test and keep the evidence.

items.name: iface_1: CDE Full TCP Port Scan
items.description: All 65535 TCP ports toward every CDE address with -Pn (ICMP filtering must not hide hosts).

finding_template.title: PCI DSS 11.4.5 segmentation failure: CDE reachable from out-of-scope segment
finding_template.description: A CDE system answered from a segment that is supposed to be isolated from the CDE. Segmentation is not operational and effective, so the source segment is in PCI DSS scope.
finding_template.remediation: Restrict the flow at the segmentation control (firewall/ACL/VLAN) to deny all traffic from out-of-scope segments to the CDE, then re-run the segmentation test and keep the evidence.

items.name: iface_1: CDE Top UDP Port Scan
items.description: Top 200 UDP ports toward the CDE. Only 'open' (not open|filtered) is treated as a failure.

groups.name: PCI CDE Service & Configuration Review
groups.description: Run from inside the CDE or a connected-to segment against {cde_scope}. Maps to PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 1.2.5 (identify ports/services), 2.2.2 (vendor defaults), 2.2.4/2.2.5 (only necessary services, insecure ones justified), 2.2.7 (encrypted non-console admin), 4.2.1 (strong crypto in transit), 11.3.1 (internal vulnerability scan).

items.name: CDE Service Inventory (Req 1.2.5)
items.description: Full TCP port + version inventory. Compare with the approved ports/services/protocols list.

items.name: Insecure / Cleartext Services (Req 2.2.5, 2.2.7)
items.description: FTP, Telnet, TFTP, r-services, POP3/IMAP, VNC, plain HTTP admin. Cleartext admin is non-compliant.

items.name: Exposed Databases & Caches (Req 1.3.1, 1.4.4)
items.description: DB/cache ports that should only be reachable from the application tier.

items.name: TLS Protocols & Ciphers (Req 4.2.1)
items.description: SSLv3/TLS 1.0/TLS 1.1 or cipher grade below B fails strong-cryptography requirements.

items.name: SSH Algorithms (Req 4.2.1, 2.2.7)
items.description: Weak KEX/cipher/MAC on SSH administrative access.

items.name: Default Web Credentials (Req 2.2.2)
items.description: Vendor default accounts on web admin consoles (Tomcat, printers, appliances, etc.).

items.name: Anonymous FTP (Req 2.2.2, 7.2)
items.description: Anonymous FTP login on CDE systems.

items.name: SNMP Default Community (Req 2.2.2)
items.description: SNMP v1/v2c answering the default 'public' community.

items.name: SMBv1 & SMB Signing (Req 2.2.4, 4.2.1)
items.description: SMBv1 enabled or SMB signing not required on CDE Windows hosts.

items.name: Internal Vulnerability Scan — vulners (Req 11.3.1)
items.description: Version-based CVE lookup (vulners NSE, needs internet). Complements, does not replace, the quarterly internal scan tool. Rescan after fixes until no high/critical remain (11.3.1.1, 11.3.1.3).

groups.name: PCI CDE Asset Identification (Keywords)
groups.description: Scope confirmation (Req 12.5.2): find systems that look like they store/process/transmit CHD but are not in {cde_scope}. CDE = systems that store/process/transmit CHD/SAD + systems in the same segment. Connected-to / security-impacting = can reach the CDE or affect its security (AD, jump hosts, PAM, logging, AV, patching, NTP, DNS) — in scope. Out-of-scope = no access to CDE and no security impact. Keywords: pci, cde, card, cards, pan, pos, payment, payments, pay, checkout, cashier, kiosk, atm, hsm, token, tokenization, tokenizer, vault, acquirer, acquiring, issuer, merchant, settlement, billing, ecom, gateway, swift, 3ds, emv, terminal.

items.name: rDNS Hostname Keyword Sweep
items.description: Reverse-DNS list scan (no packets to targets) and flag hostnames containing CDE keywords.

items.name: Web Title Keyword Sweep (non-CDE)
items.description: HTTP titles in the non-CDE range that mention payment/POS/card — possible CDE outside scope.

groups.name: PCI CHD Discovery in non-CDE (Authenticated)
groups.description: Look for cardholder data outside the CDE (Req 3.2.1, 12.5.2). Spider only prints matching paths, but WARNING: if real PAN ever lands in Bars output/DB, Bars itself becomes in-scope — do not store PAN. Uses {username}/{password}.

items.name: SMB Share Name Keywords
items.description: List readable shares in the non-CDE range and flag share names containing CDE keywords.

items.name: CHD Filename Keyword Spider
items.description: Spider C$ for file/folder names suggesting CHD (needs local admin).
items.command_template: netexec smb {non_cde_scope} -u {username} -p {password} --spider C$ --depth 6 --only-files --exclude-dirs Windows,'Program Files','Program Files (x86)',ProgramData --pattern cardholder creditcard credit_card card_number cardnumber pan_ cvv track1 track2 pci payment

items.name: PAN Content Regex Spider
items.description: Spider C$ file contents for PAN-shaped numbers (Visa/MC/Amex/Discover). Matches need Luhn + manual validation.
items.command_template: netexec smb {non_cde_scope} -u {username} -p {password} --spider C$ --depth 6 --only-files --content --exclude-dirs Windows,'Program Files','Program Files (x86)',ProgramData --regex '\b(?:4\d{3}|5[1-5]\d{2}|2[2-7]\d{2}|6011|65\d{2})[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}\b|\b3[47]\d{2}[ -]?\d{6}[ -]?\d{5}\b'

finding_template.title: PCI DSS 3.2.1: possible cardholder data outside the CDE
finding_template.remediation: Validate (Luhn + owner), securely delete or bring the system into CDE scope.
